meta.homeDescription: An Arabic ecosystem where knowledge is produced, exchanged, practised, and turned into capabilities that build the future.

common.tagline: We build knowledge, and we build people.
common.signInToSave: Sign in to save and follow.

home.title: Build your knowledge. Build yourself.
home.subtitle: BUNYAN brings communities, knowledge, practice and assessment into one Arabic-first ecosystem, where every educator and learner can shape their own educational experience.
home.missionBody: Because education is not a video playlist or a certificate on a wall. BUNYAN builds the infrastructure where knowledge is produced, exchanged, practised, and turned into capability.
home.domainsSubtitle: We start with the foundation and grow deliberately, without locking education into a single model.
home.ctaTitle: Your knowledge deserves a worthy structure.
home.ctaBody: Create your own learning community, or join an existing one, and begin a real learning journey.

principles.title: Arabic first
principles.body: An authentic Arabic interface and reading experience, with full right-to-left support.

principles.title: Understanding before memory
principles.body: We measure explanation, application and analysis — not just recall.

principles.title: Theory and practice
principles.body: Every concept is practised through exercises, projects and real case studies.

principles.title: Education is social
principles.body: Communities, discussion, peer review, mentorship and collaborative learning.

principles.title: Learners become educators
principles.body: A clear path from contribution to mentorship to teaching, earned through competence, not popularity.

principles.title: Knowledge is preserved
principles.body: A durable Arabic library of books, articles, research and learning resources.

domains.name: Community network
domains.body: Public and private communities, discussion and study groups.

domains.name: Academy system
domains.body: Independent academies, programs, curricula and pathways.

domains.name: Knowledge library
domains.body: Books, articles, research and educational resources.

domains.name: Educator studio
domains.body: Author publications and lessons, manage drafts, publish.

domains.name: Practice lab
domains.body: Assignments, projects, exercises and case studies.

domains.name: Intelligent infrastructure
domains.body: Recommendations and assistance that respect educator judgement.
